content: The oral forms of hormones have a low risk of contraceptive failure. However, caution and monitoring are advised when using them. Dapsone reduces the efficacy of the BCG live vaccine due to pharmacodynamic antagonism. This combination is contraindicated. Administration of live bacterial vaccines should be delayed until antibiotic therapy is completed. Belzutifan decreases dapsone levels or effects by altering hepatic and intestinal CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. If coadministration with sensitive CYP3A4 substrates is unavoidable, consider increasing the dose of the sensitive substrate as per prescribing information. Dapsone reduces biotin levels or effects by altering intestinal flora. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Bosentan decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Budesonide decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Dapsone and bupivacaine implants may increase each other's toxicity. Local anesthetics can elevate the risk of methemoglobinemia when combined with drugs that also cause this condition. Caution and monitoring are advised. Butabarbital and butalbital decrease dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Calcium carbonate decreases dapsone levels or effects by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Cannabidiol increases dapsone levels or effects by reducing its metabolism. Cannabidiol may inhibit CYP2C9 activity. Consider reducing the dose of CYP2C9 substrates when used concomitantly. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Carbamazepine decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Cenobamate decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Increase the dose of CYP3A4 substrates as needed when coadministered with cenobamate. Clarithromycin increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Cobicistat increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Conivaptan increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Dapsone decreases the levels or effects of conjugated estrogens by altering intestinal flora. This interaction applies only to oral forms of hormones. The risk of contraceptive failure is low. Caution and monitoring are advised. Cortisone decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Crizotinib increases dapsone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Dose reduction may be needed for coadministered drugs predominantly metabolized by CYP3A. Caution and monitoring are advised. Crofeler increases dapsone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Crofeler inhibits CYP3A4 in the gut but is unlikely to inhibit it systemically due to minimal absorption. Caution and monitoring are advised. Cyclophosphamide increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Cyclosporine increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Dabrafenib decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Danazol increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Avoid coadministration of topical dapsone with oral dapsone or antimalarial medications due to the potential for hemolytic reactions. Use an alternative drug. Darifenacin increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Darunavir increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Dasatinib increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Deferasirox decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Dexamethasone decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. DHEA (herbal) increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Didanosine increases dapsone toxicity through an unknown mechanism. This combination may increase the risk of nerve damage. Caution and monitoring are advised. Dapsone increases digoxin levels or effects by altering intestinal flora. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Caution and monitoring are advised. Disulfiram increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP2E1 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Dronedarone increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Drospirenone increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Efavirenz decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Elagolix decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Elagolix is a weak-to-moderate CYP3A4 inducer. Monitor CYP3A substrates if coadministered. Consider increasing the dose of CYP3A substrates if needed. Elvitegravir/cobicistat/emtricitabine/tenofovir DF increases dapsone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism and decreases dapsone levels by affecting CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Elvitegravir is a moderate CYP2C9 inducer. Therapy modification and close monitoring are recommended. Encorafenib both inhibits and induces CYP3A4 at clinically relevant plasma concentrations. Coadministration with sensitive CYP3A4 substrates may increase toxicity or reduce efficacy. Caution and monitoring are advised. Enzalutamide decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Erythromycin (base, ethylsuccinate, lactobionate, stearate) increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Elicarbazepine acetate decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Dapsone decreases estradiol levels or effects by altering intestinal flora. This interaction applies only to oral forms of hormones. The risk of contraceptive failure is low. Caution and monitoring are advised. Dapsone decreases the levels or effects of synthetic conjugated estrogens and estropipate by altering intestinal flora. These interactions apply only to oral forms of hormones. The risk of contraceptive failure is low. Caution and monitoring are advised. Ethanol decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP2E1 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Etravirine decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Famotidine decreases dapsone levels or effects by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Fedratinib increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Adjust the dose of CYP3A4 substrates as necessary. Caution and monitoring are advised. Fexinidazole increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Fexinidazole inhibits CYP3A4. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Fluconazole increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Fludrocortisone decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Fosamprenavir increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Fosaprepitant increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Fosphenytoin decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Ganciclovir increases dapsone toxicity through pharmacodynamic synergism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Grapefruit increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Griseofulvin decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Hydrocortisone decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Ibuprofen/famotidine decreases dapsone levels or effects by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Idelalisib increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Idelalisib is a strong CYP3A inhibitor. Avoid coadministration with sensitive CYP3A substrates. Iloperidone increases dapsone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Iloperidone is a time-dependent CYP3A inhibitor and may elevate plasma levels of drugs predominantly eliminated by CYP3A4. Caution and monitoring are advised. Indinavir increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Isoniazid increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP2E1 and CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Istradefylline increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. At 40 mg/day, it increased peak levels and AUC of CYP3A4 substrates in clinical trials. This effect was not observed at 20 mg/day. Consider dose reduction of sensitive CYP3A4 substrates. Ivosidenib decreases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 and CYP2C9/10 metabolism. Avoid coadministration with sensitive CYP3A4 or CYP2C9 substrates. If unavoidable, monitor patients for loss of therapeutic effect. Ketoconazole increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised. Lansoprazole decreases dapsone levels or effects by increasing gastric pH. This interaction applies only to the oral forms of both agents. Avoid or use an alternative drug. Lapatinib increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Larotrectinib increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. The clinical significance is minor or unknown. Lenacapavir increases dapsone levels or effects by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Lenacapavir, a moderate CYP3A4 inhibitor, may increase CYP3A4 substrates initiated within 9 months after the last SC dose of lenacapavir, potentially increasing the risk of adverse reactions. Caution and monitoring are advised. Letermovir increases dapsone levels by affecting CYP3A4 metabolism. Caution and monitoring are advised.
